Skill.constraints[0]: Use when tasks involve reading, creating, or reviewing PDF files where rendering and layout matter; prefer visual
checks by rendering pages (Poppler) and use Python tools such as `reportlab`, `pdfplumber`, and `pypdf` for generation and
Skill.constraints[1]: Read or review PDF content where layout and visuals matter.
Skill.constraints[2]: Create PDFs programmatically with reliable formatting.
Skill.constraints[3]: Validate final rendering before delivery.
Skill.constraints[4]: Use tmp/pdfs/ for intermediate files; delete when done.
Skill.constraints[5]: Write final artifacts under output/pdf/ when working in this repo.
Skill.constraints[6]: Keep filenames stable and descriptive.
Skill.constraints[10]: Maintain polished visual design: consistent typography, spacing, margins, and section hierarchy.
Skill.constraints[11]: Avoid rendering issues: clipped text, overlapping elements, broken tables, black squares, or unreadable glyphs.
Skill.constraints[12]: Charts, tables, and images must be sharp, aligned, and clearly labeled.
Skill.constraints[13]: Use ASCII hyphens only. Avoid U+2011 (non-breaking hyphen) and other Unicode dashes.
Skill.constraints[14]: Citations and references must be human-readable; never leave tool tokens or placeholder strings.
Skill.constraints[15]: Do not deliver until the latest PNG inspection shows zero visual or formatting defects.
Skill.constraints[16]: Confirm headers/footers, page numbering, and section transitions look polished.
Skill.constraints[17]: Keep intermediate files organized or remove them after final approval.
